name: c2pa-disclosure
description: Classify Amplience DAM assets by AI provenance using C2PA Content Credentials, and record the verdict as asset metadata for EU AI Act disclosure labelling.
//engines: Node 16 is the tested floor. @contentauth/c2pa-node declares >=22, but nothing in its runtime path needs it: the native addon is built against napi-6 (Node 12.17+), and its only runtime deps are fs-extra (>=14.14) and two packages declaring no engines. Its >=18 dep, pkg-dir, is postinstall-only. Verified reading and validating a signed asset on 16.20.2 with results identical to 22.
//main: The Amplience processing-job runner reads this field to find the entry point, so it must be the CLI, not a library module.
